materialRecipe.metadataSource: Actual GLB material/image bindings and embedded KTX2 DFD/header; codec and dimensions are not inferred from filenames.

compression.lightmaps: Basis UASTC + Zstandard, per-pass log2 HDR in linear KTX2 samples; decode logRange/logGain before lighting

optimization.sourceFaceSelection: Exact prepared FACE triangle-position multiset + original region + reservedUV2 marker, with unique candidate population verified before mutation. Material names may deduplicate; marker alone never authorizes removal.

contactPadding.geometryApplicability: Padding certified on exact F32 input; production geometry preserves every retained visible position/UV/color/material attribute and original source bake occluders are retained in the immutable bake source.

codecVerification.scope: Actual compressed maps plus official RGBA8 transcode compared with denoised EXR. Base checks all chart cores; coarser mips check only texels whose full child footprint remains one chart. Reference mip averaging happens in linear radiance. Device ASTC/BC7/ETC output and screen interpolation still require runtime capture review.

sourceNightLighting.meaning: Authored accepted source lighting, restored exactly for night except visitor lamp omitted. Positions/rotations use Blender coordinates; source socket colours are linear.

transportProvenance.meaning: Original64-sample Metal/Cycles+MetalOIDN transport, unchanged. Sampling-domain padding is a separately bound image derivative.
